name: degraded_policy_from_bc
description: Degraded-policy training initialized from the same BC checkpoint as clean_policy_from_bc. Trains pi_D under M_D - the hardware degradation model. M_D injects motor torque reduction, control latency, IMU noise, IMU bias, and ground friction variance to simulate the failure modes of low-cost hardware. The performance gap between this policy and pi_C when both are evaluated in M_D is the core experimental result of the paper.
note: Keep this config aligned with clean retraining except for degradation parameters; consistency is required for fair comparisons.
